description.p: Optimization pack: Klia Store now uses noticeably less RAM while running. You shouldn't notice any change in how the app looks or behaves — just a lighter footprint on your system.
Fixed an issue where installing a .flatpak file by double-clicking it could fail with a file-not-found error when Klia Store is running as a sandboxed Flatpak app.
Installing a .flatpak file by opening it directly now updates the app's status right away, so it correctly shows as installed without needing to restart Klia Store.
General performance improvements across the app: faster loading of the Home screen, quicker app searches, and a smaller, more efficient install.
Improved stability: the app is now more resilient if something goes wrong during an installation, avoiding unexpected crashes.
